description:
Hi! We are a Spyrosoft Synergy team specializing in HMI development. We are looking for freelance Qt/QML developers fluent in French to work on designing and developing cutting-edge human-machine interfaces for in-vehicle infotainment systems, industry 4.0 solutions, and more.

Requirements:

  • QML

  • Qt

  • C++

  • English C1

  • French C1

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in software development

  • Commercial experience in QML cross-platform applications development (min. 1 year)

  • Experience in developing Qt based GUI

  • Strong C++ programming skills (including modern C++)

  • Knowledge about architecture and design patterns

  • Familiar with version control, code review, and integration tools

  • Communicative in English (written and spoken)

  • Communicative in French (written and spoken)

Nice to have:

  • Experienced in using AI tools in day-to-day workflow

  • Understand Agile methodology & Proof of Concept

  • Experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto)

  • Docker knowledge

  • Programming experience in Python

  • Experience with open source projects

Why is it worth joining the Spyrosoft team?🔥

➡️We are a certified Premium partner of The Qt Company. Our collaboration is part of the Qt Service Partner program and aims to create an ecosystem to facilitate the development of new Qt solutions. You can help us do that!

➡️You will work closely with The Qt Company’s R&D departments and have the chance to thrive on our own R&D projects for which we have allocated budgets.

➡️Together, we will create Qt applications for everything from smart home devices through car solutions to surgeon support software. No more tedious and long–term maintenance projects.

➡️We give you influence over the development of architecture.

➡️We are HMI enthusiasts, always eager to share our experience and knowledge with new team members.

➡️We focus on the modern approach to the Qt community. With us, you have the opportunity to do lectures at large events like QtWS or training for outside companies.
